bodySections.heading: Why Building Regulations Is Essential in Real Estate & Construction
bodySections.content: Employers look for verified proficiency in Building Regulations to ensure team productivity, project accuracy, and modern technical capability. Candidates with demonstrated Building Regulations expertise consistently outperform those with only theoretical knowledge.
bulletPoints: Building Regulations is listed as a required skill in over 60% of real estate & construction job postings.
Employers prioritise candidates with verifiable skills over self-declared expertise.
Proficiency in Building Regulations accelerates career progression by 1–3 years on average.
Use TalentXcel Skills Assessment to verify and showcase your proficiency.

bodySections.heading: How to Learn and Demonstrate Building Regulations
bodySections.content: The most effective way to build Building Regulations proficiency is through a combination of structured learning, hands-on project work, and verified assessment. Showcasing your skill through a verified credential on TalentXcel significantly improves recruiter visibility.
bulletPoints: Start with structured online courses covering Building Regulations fundamentals.
Build 2–3 real portfolio projects that demonstrate practical application.
Complete the TalentXcel Skills Assessment to earn a verified credential.
List the credential on your Career Passport and resume.
